# EcoCommons Data Audit

Welcome. This site collects **data-audit** write-ups for the [EcoCommons Australia](https://www.ecocommons.org.au/) and Biosecurity Commons platforms — the behind-the-scenes work of figuring out *what data we actually have*, whether it matches what the science needs, and how the answers were obtained so anyone can reproduce them.

## Posts

### 1. Auditing the EcoCommons Production Data Catalogue

[Auditing the EcoCommons Production Data Catalogue](ecocommons_prod_data_audit.qmd)\
How we enumerated **every** dataset in the EcoCommons production environment — 58,424 records across ~54 collections — using the data-ingester Elasticsearch endpoint, and what the catalogue actually contains.
